text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.Be in good health condition 3.Applicant should be less than 40 4.HSK level 6 or above 5.Graduated with a Bachelor's degree Note: Applicants without HSK certificate (level 6 or above) should attend Mandarin level test of the university,and thosewho get the result equivalent to HSK level 6 or above can be considered.
